Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 113: September 2010
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #113 shipped to subscribers in August 2010 (bearing the cover date of September 2010 for Issue 113). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #113 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom downloadable content, and exclusive media previews:

Vanquish (third-person sci-fi shooter)
NBA 2K11 (sports simulation)
Pro Evolution Soccer 2011 (sports simulation)
Sonic the Hedgehog 4: Episode I (Xbox Live Arcade 2D platformer)
Comic Jumper: The Adventures of Captain Smiley (Xbox Live Arcade action-platformer)
Super Meat Boy (Xbox Live Arcade precision platformer)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews--featuring coverage for Call of Duty: Black Ops, Halo: Reach, and Assassin's Creed: Brotherhood, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
